prompt: Stage 5-1, level 8, 61 gold, 28 HP, five players left. Aphelios is 1-star with Rageblade, Infinity Edge and Last Whisper. Scouting: Seat 1 has a 2-star Aphelios plus two spare copies, Seat 4 has a 2-star, Seat 6 has one and is at 9 HP. Nobody in the lobby plays Sivir, and one is in your shop. What is the rolldown target?

lobby.note: Aphelios 2-star with two spare copies on the bench
Coven Morgana; no Sivir anywhere in the lobby

options.label: Buy the Sivir, move the three items to her, roll to 10 for her 2-star and sell Aphelios once she is in
Roll to 10 for Aphelios: Seat 6 dies this round and his copy comes back, and the shop only has to show two
Hold 50, level 9 at 5-2 and roll there for a 5-cost carry instead of any 4-cost
Keep Aphelios and roll for Rapidfire 2-stars around him; a 1-star carry with the trait still does damage

explanation:
Count. Ten Aphelios exist: you hold one, Seat 1 five, Seat 4 three, Seat 6 one. That is ten. The pool has zero, a shop cannot show what is not in the pool, and a rolldown for Aphelios hits nothing until someone dies. When Seat 6 goes, one copy returns: one in roughly 115 four-cost copies, 0.26% per slot, one shop in 75. You need two.

The items are the carry, not the unit. Rageblade, Infinity Edge and Last Whisper fit any ranged AD 4-cost, and Sivir is one nobody holds: ten copies in the pool, about 2.6% per slot, one shop in eight, and twenty-odd shops find two more copies most of the time. You lose Rapidfire on the carry and gain a 2-star with three items, which beats a 1-star with a trait every time. Levelling to 9 at 28 HP means one loss at 20 damage before you have rolled at all. Rolling for bodies around a carry who cannot kill anything fixes the wrong half of the board.
principle: When the pool count says zero, the target changes, not the floor. Items make a carry; the champion is whoever the pool can still give you.
commonMistake: Rolling for the unit the items were built for after the lobby has bought every copy of it.
hint: Add up every Aphelios you can see across the other four players and compare the total with the size of a 4-cost pool.
